title: Condensation of Amines with S-Methyl Thiouronium Salts: Another Entry for the Synthesis of Amidines
abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>We present a condensation of primary aryl or alkyl amines with S-methyl thiouronium salts to obtain N,N,N′-trisubstituted amidines. High yields, short reaction times, and a fair substrate scope are the noteworthy features of this protocol. Surprisingly, the reaction of a thiouronium salt with 4-aminopyridine gave 1-(4-methoxybenzoyl)piperidine.</jats:p>
